lines.zh: 我喷出一股水，向前滑行
lines.en: I jet a burst of water and glide ahead

lines.zh: 螺旋壳切开侏罗纪的海水
lines.en: My spiral shell cuts the Jurassic sea

lines.zh: 触腕先探出去，壳身随后跟上
lines.en: Tentacles probe first; the shell follows

lines.zh: 海床的泥沙在我身下缓缓退开
lines.en: Sandy floor slides by beneath me

lines.zh: 我调了调壳里的气室，慢慢下沉
lines.en: I trim the chambers in my shell and sink

lines.zh: 水从壳口灌进来，推着我走
lines.en: Water floods my aperture and pushes me on

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石转了半圈
lines.en: I sweep half a turn along the reef

lines.zh: 一队小鱼在前面散开
lines.en: A school of small fish scatters ahead

lines.zh: 我的壳壁上还挂着海藻
lines.en: Seaweed still clings to my shell

lines.zh: 我从亮处滑进更深的水
lines.en: I slide from the light into deeper water

lines.zh: 壳里的气室替我浮着
lines.en: The chambers in my shell keep me afloat

lines.zh: 水流过我的触腕，很轻
lines.en: Current slips over my tentacles, softly

lines.zh: 一条鱼从壳边游过，没看见我
lines.en: A fish passes my shell without seeing me

lines.zh: 我听见远处礁石上的敲击声
lines.en: I hear knocking far off on the reef

lines.zh: 我的壳反射出一点点光
lines.en: My shell throws back a little light

lines.zh: 我慢慢吐出一串气泡
lines.en: I let out a slow string of bubbles

lines.zh: 这片海很安静，安静得很旧
lines.en: This sea is quiet, an ancient quiet

lines.zh: 我卷起一条触腕，又松开
lines.en: I curl one tentacle and let it go

lines.zh: 泥沙落下，盖住了我的影子
lines.en: Silt settles and covers my shadow

lines.zh: 我想起自己的化石在英格兰
lines.en: I recall my fossil lies in England

lines.zh: 光线从水面斜下来，一条一条
lines.en: Light comes down in slanted stripes

lines.zh: 我转了转壳口，尝了尝水
lines.en: I turn my aperture and taste the water

lines.zh: 有什么在远处游动，我感觉得到
lines.en: Something swims far off; I feel it

lines.zh: 我不需要睡，只需要等着
lines.en: I need no sleep, only waiting

lines.zh: 我的壳一层一层，全是时间
lines.en: My shell is layer on layer of time

lines.zh: 你停在我壳前，水里都是你的影子
lines.en: You stop before my shell; your shadow fills the water

lines.zh: 你的脚还在踩水，我听得清
lines.en: You're still treading water; I hear every kick

lines.zh: 我伸出两条触腕，只是探一探
lines.en: I extend two tentacles, only to probe

lines.zh: 你比鱼大得多，可我不怕
lines.en: You're far bigger than a fish, but I'm not afraid

lines.zh: 我的壳口正对着你
lines.en: My aperture faces you

lines.zh: 你在水里呼出的泡，一串串往上
lines.en: Your bubbles rise in strings

lines.zh: 别把手伸到壳口来
lines.en: Don't put your hand near my aperture

lines.zh: 你身上的铁味在水里散得很快
lines.en: The iron smell on you spreads fast underwater

lines.zh: 我绕着你看了一圈
lines.en: I circle once to look you over

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在追我的壳纹
lines.en: Your eyes follow the ridges of my shell

lines.zh: 我慢慢升起，又沉下去
lines.en: I rise slowly, then sink again

lines.zh: 你要抓我，得先追上水
lines.en: To catch me you must outswim the water

lines.zh: 我的壳被撞得咯咯响
lines.en: My shell rattles from the blow

lines.zh: 我喷水想退开
lines.en: I jet water to get away

lines.zh: 触腕全缩回壳口
lines.en: My tentacles snap back into the aperture

lines.zh: 我螺旋壳上添了道白痕
lines.en: A white scar now crosses my spiral shell

lines.zh: 我沉向海床，躲进泥里
lines.en: I sink to the bed and burrow in

lines.zh: 水里的血味让我发慌
lines.en: The taste of my own blood unsettles me

lines.zh: 我歪了一下，浮力乱了
lines.en: I lurch as my buoyancy slips

lines.zh: 我绕着壳身自己转了一圈
lines.en: I spin about my own shell

lines.zh: 疼得我收紧了壳口
lines.en: The pain makes me clamp my aperture shut

lines.zh: 我等了一会儿，才敢再动
lines.en: I wait a while before I dare move

lines.zh: 那条鱼，往我这边赶
lines.en: That fish; drive it my way

lines.zh: 腥味在水里散开，我闻到了
lines.en: The smell of fish spreads; I taste it

lines.zh: 我的触腕全伸了出来
lines.en: Every tentacle of mine reaches out

lines.zh: 再靠近一点，我就卷住它
lines.en: A little closer and I'll coil around it

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼还在拍水
lines.en: The fish in your hand still slaps

lines.zh: 我卷了一下，滑掉了
lines.en: I grab and it slips free

lines.zh: 这条太小，塞不住我的喙
lines.en: That's too small for my beak

lines.zh: 我追着它绕了半圈礁石
lines.en: I chase it half around the reef

lines.zh: 你把鱼放下，退开就好
lines.en: Drop the fish and back away

lines.zh: 我吃得很慢，你可以看
lines.en: I eat slowly; you may watch

lines.zh: 你撞在我的壳上，硬得很
lines.en: You hit my shell, and it's hard

lines.zh: 我被推得偏了方向
lines.en: The shove turns me off course

lines.zh: 你的手滑过壳脊，划了一道
lines.en: Your hand slides along a ridge, leaving a line

lines.zh: 我沉了一下，把你挤出水面
lines.en: I drop and push you up out of the water

lines.zh: 壳口擦过你的腿
lines.en: My aperture grazes your leg

lines.zh: 我们一起搅起一团泥沙
lines.en: Together we stir up a cloud of silt

lines.zh: 我被撞得壳里嗡嗡响
lines.en: The knock echoes inside my shell

lines.zh: 你退了，我也调了个头
lines.en: You pull back; I turn about

lines.zh: 别推我的壳口，那儿软
lines.en: Don't push at my aperture; it's soft

lines.zh: 我们都停住，泥沙慢慢落下
lines.en: We both stop and the silt settles

lines.zh: 水里传来另一只壳的回响
lines.en: Another shell answers in the water

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，螺旋朝着同一边
lines.en: We float side by side, spirals turned the same way

lines.zh: 我们用触腕互相碰了碰
lines.en: Our tentacles touch and part

lines.zh: 她的壳比我的更白一点
lines.en: Her shell is a shade whiter than mine

lines.zh: 我们把卵沉到礁石缝里
lines.en: We settle our eggs into a reef crevice

lines.zh: 水把我们推近，又推开
lines.en: The water brings us close and pushes us apart

lines.zh: 她的气室响了一声，很轻
lines.en: Her chambers tick once, faintly

lines.zh: 我们一起沉向海底
lines.en: We sink toward the sea floor together

lines.zh: 这段海沟以后有两个壳
lines.en: Two shells share this trench now

lines.zh: 我用触腕把它卷起来
lines.en: I curl a tentacle around it

lines.zh: 它沉得比鱼厉害
lines.en: It's heavier than any fish

lines.zh: 我用喙咬了一下，咬不动
lines.en: I test it with my beak; it won't give

lines.zh: 它在水里发着微光
lines.en: It glimmers faintly in the water

lines.zh: 我卷着它绕着壳转
lines.en: I carry it once around my shell

lines.zh: 它从我触腕间滑走了
lines.en: It slips out from my tentacles

lines.zh: 我把它压进沙里藏好
lines.en: I press it into the sand to hide it

lines.zh: 这个我要带进壳口看看
lines.en: This one goes to my aperture for a look

lines.zh: 它碰在壳上，声音很闷
lines.en: It knocks my shell with a dull sound

lines.zh: 我留着，也许能换个地方
lines.en: I'll keep it; maybe it's worth trading

lines.zh: 你一动，我的触腕就转了方向
lines.en: You move and my tentacles turn your way

lines.zh: 我听见你在水里喘
lines.en: I hear you breathing hard underwater

lines.zh: 我慢慢升到你的高度
lines.en: I rise slowly to your level

lines.zh: 壳口对准了你的方向
lines.en: My aperture lines up with you

lines.zh: 你的血味在水里散开了吗
lines.en: Has your blood reached the water yet

lines.zh: 我不需要追，水会把你送来
lines.en: I needn't chase; the water brings you

lines.zh: 我先绕到你的下游
lines.en: I slip around to your downstream side

lines.zh: 你退向礁石，那就更好了
lines.en: You back toward the reef; better still

lines.zh: 我的壳挡住了你的退路
lines.en: My shell blocks your way out

lines.zh: 触腕一条条伸展开了
lines.en: My tentacles unroll one by one

lines.zh: 我认准了你的动作
lines.en: I've read your movement

lines.zh: 这一片海我要了
lines.en: I claim this patch of sea

lines.zh: 你游得不错，可惜不够快
lines.en: You swim well, but not well enough

lines.zh: 现在我盯着你
lines.en: Now I'm watching you

lines.zh: 我跟着你的水痕走
lines.en: I follow the trail of water you leave

lines.zh: 你往上浮，我就跟上去
lines.en: You rise and I rise with you

lines.zh: 我一点一点把距离收窄
lines.en: I narrow the distance bit by bit

lines.zh: 我的壳像一堵慢慢靠近的墙
lines.en: My shell is a wall closing in slowly

lines.zh: 你换方向，我的触腕先转
lines.en: You turn and my tentacles turn first

lines.zh: 水里到处都是我的响动
lines.en: The water carries my sound everywhere

lines.zh: 我等着你气用尽
lines.en: I wait for your air to run out

lines.zh: 你踢起泥沙想躲，没用
lines.en: You kick up silt to hide; it won't work

lines.zh: 我压着水，慢慢下沉
lines.en: I press the water down and settle lower

lines.zh: 你每一下划水我都看见
lines.en: I see every stroke you take

lines.zh: 礁石缝太窄，我堵在外面
lines.en: The crevice is too narrow; I wait outside

lines.zh: 我不着急，海很大，你很小
lines.en: No hurry; the sea is large and you are small

lines.zh: 壳口一张一合，像在呼吸
lines.en: My aperture opens and closes as if breathing

lines.zh: 我绕着你画了一圈
lines.en: I draw a circle around you

lines.zh: 你退到沙底，那就没得躲了
lines.en: You drop to the sand; then there's nowhere left

lines.zh: 我停了下来，只是看着
lines.en: I stop and simply watch

lines.zh: 触腕缠上你的手臂
lines.en: A tentacle coils around your arm

lines.zh: 我的壳横撞过去
lines.en: My shell swings across and hits

lines.zh: 喙在壳口里咬合，咔一声
lines.en: My beak snaps inside the aperture

lines.zh: 我把你往水下带
lines.en: I drag you down through the water

lines.zh: 触腕在你护甲上打滑
lines.en: My tentacles slip off your armor

lines.zh: 这一下卷空了，水被搅浑
lines.en: I grab nothing and the water muddies

lines.zh: 壳脊刮过你的腿
lines.en: My shell ridge rakes your leg

lines.zh: 我喷水后退，再冲过来
lines.en: I jet backward, then charge again

lines.zh: 你被缠住的那只手麻了
lines.en: The hand you lost feels numb

lines.zh: 我的喙撕开一道口子
lines.en: My beak opens a seam in you

lines.zh: 我把你甩向礁石
lines.en: I throw you against the reef

lines.zh: 你在水里翻了个身，才挣脱
lines.en: You tumble once before tearing free

lines.zh: 我沉下去，从下方顶上来
lines.en: I sink, then strike up from below

lines.zh: 触腕收回，我的壳又对准你
lines.en: Tentacles retract and my shell aims again

lines.zh: 水底浮起一个巨大的螺旋
lines.en: A vast spiral rises from the sea floor

lines.zh: 我的壳先出现，影子盖住礁石
lines.en: My shell appears first, shadowing the reef

lines.zh: 一股水从我壳口喷出来
lines.en: A jet of water bursts from my aperture

lines.zh: 我从泥沙里抬起壳身
lines.en: I lift my shell out of the silt

lines.zh: 这片海原本没有这么大的东西
lines.en: This sea had nothing this large before

lines.zh: 我的触腕在暗处先动起来
lines.en: My tentacles stir first in the dark

lines.zh: 水面上冒出一圈泡，然后是我
lines.en: Bubbles break the surface, then me

lines.zh: 古老的壳纹在水里泛着光
lines.en: Old shell ridges gleam underwater

lines.zh: 我转了半圈，看清周围
lines.en: I turn half about and read my surroundings

lines.zh: 鱼群一下子全散了
lines.en: Every fish is gone in an instant

lines.zh: 我慢慢浮起来，像一块会动的石头
lines.en: I rise like a stone that learned to move

lines.zh: 壳里的气室一齐响了一下
lines.en: Every chamber in my shell ticks at once

lines.zh: 我从很深的地方上来
lines.en: I come up from very deep

lines.zh: 英格兰的岩层里，我曾经这样
lines.en: In English stone I lay like this once

lines.zh: 我的壳口对着光，慢慢张开
lines.en: My aperture opens slowly toward the light

lines.zh: 我落在海床上，泥沙升起
lines.en: I settle on the bed and silt blooms up

lines.zh: 有什么在附近游动，我醒了
lines.en: Something swims near, and I wake

lines.zh: 我先闻水，再看你
lines.en: I taste the water first, then look at you

lines.zh: 触腕伸出来，试了试温度
lines.en: Tentacles test the temperature

lines.zh: 我来了，这片水就不一样了
lines.en: I'm here; the water feels different now

lines.zh: 热水烫着我的壳口，我往下钻
lines.en: The water scalds my aperture; I dive

lines.zh: 我从高处跌下，壳先撞在石上
lines.en: I drop and my shell takes the stone first

lines.zh: 我竟被水闷住了，壳口发闷
lines.en: The water stifles me; my aperture aches

lines.zh: 爆震把我掀得翻了个身
lines.en: The blast rolls me over

lines.zh: 一支箭钉进了我的壳脊
lines.en: An arrow lodges in my shell ridge

lines.zh: 那股怪力擦过壳，里面嗡嗡作响
lines.en: That strange force grazes my shell and it hums

lines.zh: 水里再没有鱼，我的触腕发软
lines.en: No fish left; my tentacles go limp

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整只壳一颤
lines.en: Lightning enters the water and my shell shudders

lines.zh: 连水也没有了，我无处可喷
lines.en: There's no water left for me to jet against
